notes: All timing units are milliseconds. p50/p95 are medians of per-run quantiles.
No-match rows use an id-dependent predicate and separate 5-run confirmations.
Raw query timings execute the full engine even when the public search bypasses it.
Materialization counts are from the synthetic finalization probe, not timings; real-corpus rows have no materialization counter.
Retained-result memory is measured after GC and is not transient allocation or peak RSS.
